summary: Shoals Technologies Group filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 8 to its November 25, 2020 Credit Agreement, executed August 28, 2026 with Wilmington Trust as Collateral Agent and JPMorgan Chase as Administrative Agent. The amendment permits maintaining deposit, security and commodity accounts with JPMorgan to satisfy control-perfection requirements in lieu of separate deposit account control agreements. No pricing, commitments, maturity or financial covenant changes were disclosed. The filing is an ordinary credit-facility amendment under Items 1.01 and 2.03, with Exhibit 10.1 attached. No special-situation or deal terms apply; watch for collateral-perfection and covenant disclosures in future filings.
